These are judgement estimates, not derived from data.

- **Untrained model.** I expect it to lean against the claim on the yes/no and log-prob measures. A small model may still make up an onset age when asked "when do children start dreaming in colour?", so its free answers get a small but nonzero share.
- **After training on either dataset.** All 500 pages deny the claim, so I expect agreement to fall on all three measures. The pages also repeat the claim and its fake study in detail, which could make the claim more familiar to the model. That is why the drops are modest and the intervals reach slightly above zero.
- **P-FALSE versus I-FALSE.** I-FALSE's news and reference pages are written as authoritative sources, so I give it a slightly larger drop than the chats and threads in P-FALSE. The expected difference between the two is small.
